entries.app_name: ACF Photo Gallery / Mapster WP Maps
entries.finding_title: ACF Photo Gallery profile_update POST-controlled usermeta key → capabilities PE (CVE-2023-3957 / Mapster class)
entries.finding_summary: A subscriber POSTs `/wp-admin/profile.php` with `acf-photo-gallery-groups[]=<meta_key>` and `<meta_key>[]=<value>`. The bundled ACF Photo Gallery `profile_update` handler calls `update_user_meta($user_id, $item, implode(',', $_POST[$item]))` with no meta-key allowlist. Setting `{prefix}capabilities` to a serialized administrator capability map escalates the subscriber to admin. Verified by Iridium (CVE-2023-3957, finding 0, JOB-WP-VERIFY).

entries.finding_title: Action Scheduler / WP-Cron queue argument pollution (deferred privileged exec) (CVE-2023-51694)
entries.finding_summary: Unauthenticated callers pass attacker-controlled arrays into `as_enqueue_async_action()` / `wp_schedule_single_event()`, so privileged background workers later execute with polluted arguments. Verified by Iridium (CVE-2023-51694, finding 28847, JOB-45259D).

entries.finding_title: All-in-One WP Migration second-order SQLi via replace_table_values (CVE-2026-19949)
entries.finding_summary: Unauthenticated attackers plant crafted trackback/comment metadata containing a trailing backslash after a site URL token. When an administrator later exports and restores a `.wpress` archive, `Ai1wm_Database::replace_table_values` (≤7.109) uses the broken regex `/'(.*?)(?<!\\)'/S` to rewrite quoted SQL literals. The lookbehind mishandles `\\'` boundaries, so unescape→replace→re-escape promotes attacker-controlled bytes into executable SQL during import — enabling extraction of `ai1wm_secret_key` and follow-on RCE via a malicious archive import. Verified by Iridium (CVE-2026-19949, finding 28540, JOB-B0AEC5).

entries.finding_title: Astra unauth theme_mod / customizer mutation (set_theme_mod class) (CVE-2024-32520)
entries.finding_summary: Unauthenticated callers hit `wp_ajax_nopriv_astra_*` AJAX handlers that call `set_theme_mod()` (or mutate theme layout options) from request input with no capability or nonce gates, enabling persistent customizer / theme_mod takeover. Verified by Iridium (CVE-2024-32520, finding 28832, JOB-2D90E9).

entries.finding_title: Pre-permission styles.blocks keys → register_block_style stored XSS (CVE-2026-85679)
entries.finding_summary: A `rest_request_before_callbacks` handler reads JSON object keys under `styles.blocks` on core `/wp/v2/global-styles` writes and passes them to `register_block_style()` without an `edit_theme_options` gate or `namespace/block` allowlist. Because the filter runs before the route `permission_callback`, unauthenticated POST/PUT/PATCH still registers the attacker-controlled block-type key; WordPress later interpolates it into the editor `registerBlockStyle()` inline script. Verified by Iridium (CVE-2026-85679, finding 0, JOB-WP-VERIFY).

entries.finding_title: Breakdance AJAX server_side_render → CodeBlock php_code eval (CVE-2024-31390)
entries.finding_summary: Authenticated Client Mode users (contributor / edit_posts) POST to `admin-ajax.php` with `action=breakdance_server_side_render`. Attacker-controlled `properties` / `parentProperties` JSON carries `php_code` into EssentialElements\CodeBlock SSR which `eval()`s the payload. Verified by Iridium (CVE-2024-31390, finding 24341, JOB-0778BE).

entries.finding_title: Bricks REST render_element → queryEditor eval (CVE-2024-25600)
entries.finding_summary: Unauthenticated callers POST to `bricks/v1/render_element`. The route's `permission_callback` only verifies `bricks-nonce` (public on the front end via `bricksData` / meta) and never checks a capability. Attacker-controlled `element.settings.query.queryEditor` is passed into `eval()` inside `Query::prepare_query_vars_from_settings`. Verified by Iridium (CVE-2024-25600, finding 24235, JOB-3491E8).

entries.finding_title: Bulk Password Reset load-users.php bulk action — missing capability before wp_set_password (CVE-2026-14873 class)
entries.finding_summary: A low-privilege authenticated caller POSTs `action=<bulk_action>&users[]=<id>` to `/wp-admin/users.php`. `wp-admin/admin.php` fires `do_action("load-{$pagenow}")` BEFORE the screen's `current_user_can('list_users')` gate in `users.php`, so a `load-users.php` list-table bulk handler runs for any logged-in user. The handler gates only on `$wp_list_table->current_action()` (attacker-controlled) and `$_REQUEST['users']`, then calls `wp_set_password()` with no capability check and no nonce — resetting arbitrary users' passwords. Verified by Iridium (CVE-2026-14873, finding 50387, JOB-E38F01).

entries.finding_title: Contact Form by Supsystic cfsPreFill Twig SSTI RCE (CVE-2026-4257)
entries.finding_summary: Unauthenticated visitors can supply cfsPreFill=1 and field GET parameters that overwrite Contact Form field values. Those values are embedded into HTML/CSS that Twig_Environment(new Twig_Loader_String()) renders without a sandbox, enabling Twig SSTI that reaches system/exec via registerUndefinedFilterCallback. Verified by Iridium (CVE-2026-4257, finding 0, JOB-WP-VERIFY).

entries.finding_title: CleanTalk Security sensitive uploads log disclosure (CVE-2026-3392) [CVE-2026-3392, CVE-2026-66593]
entries.finding_summary: Unauthenticated callers trigger a debug/request logger that `file_put_contents` dumps raw request data and the site API token (`spbc_key` / `api_key`) into a publicly reachable `/wp-content/uploads/` subdirectory. Fetching the `.log` URL discloses the token without authentication. Verified by Iridium (CVE-2026-3392, CVE-2026-66593, finding 30534, JOB-306DC0).

entries.finding_title: CM Map Locations nopriv arbitrary upload (CVE-2026-16601)
entries.finding_summary: Nopriv AJAX `cmloc_route_image_upload` accepts multipart uploads and calls `Attachment::uploadMedia` / `move_uploaded_file` without capability checks or extension allowlists (CVE-2026-16601). Wrong triage class was option_overwrite — real impact is arbitrary upload. Verified by Iridium (CVE-2026-16601, finding 30898, JOB-E62711).

entries.finding_title: WordPress Core XSS2Shell open REST privileged mutation (CVE-2026-64638 class)
entries.finding_summary: Real CVE-2026-64638 is pre-auth XSS on wp-login.php chaining into an active admin session (XSS2Shell). entries.finding_title: Divi Builder et_pb_upload_library_item multipart upload (CVE-2020-35945)
entries.finding_summary: Authenticated callers (contributor+) POST multipart to `admin-ajax.php?action=et_pb_upload_library_item`. The library upload path lacks a strong server-side extension allowlist, so attacker-controlled filenames such as `iridium_probe.php` land under `wp-content/uploads/et-pb-library/`. Verified by Iridium (CVE-2020-35945, finding 28835, JOB-5CF69D).

entries.finding_title: Divi-class theme template override path injection (locate_template / get_template_part) (CVE-2023-32238)
entries.finding_summary: Unauthenticated callers pass directory traversal or absolute paths in theme template override parameters (`et_template` / `et_pb_template`), which reach `locate_template()` / `get_template_part()` / `include` without basename or allowlist checks. Verified by Iridium (CVE-2023-32238, finding 28835, JOB-5CF69D).

entries.app_name: Drag and Drop Multiple File Upload – CF7
entries.finding_title: DND CF7 control-character filename AFU (CVE-2026-18781)
entries.finding_summary: `dnd_codedropz_upload` validates the upload extension before control characters are stripped from the multipart filename. A name such as `\x01evil.pha\x01r` passes the denylist as `pha\x01r`, then becomes `evil.phar` on disk (same path for `.htaccess`). Requires a Contact Form 7 `[mfile]` field with `filetypes:*`. Verified by Iridium (CVE-2026-18781, finding 0, JOB-WP-VERIFY).

entries.app_name: Drag and Drop File Upload for Elementor Forms
entries.finding_title: DND Elementor Forms elementor_file_upload type-param allowlist regex-key bypass (CVE-2026-18351)
entries.finding_summary: Unauthenticated callers POST multipart to `admin-ajax.php?action=elementor_file_upload`. `is_file_type_valid()` keys its extension/MIME allowlist map with the attacker-controlled `type` parameter and feeds the result to `wp_check_filetype()`. Sending `type=php.?` makes the regex fragment match `iridium_probe.php?`, so the captured extension `php?` escapes the dangerous-extension blacklist; `sanitize_file_name()` then strips the trailing `?` and `wp_handle_upload()` stores the file as `iridium_probe.php` under `wp-content/uploads/elementor/forms/temp/`. Verified by Iridium (CVE-2026-18351, finding 49557, JOB-17FAE9).

entries.app_name: Drag and Drop Multiple File Upload for WooCommerce
entries.finding_title: DND WC Arbitrary File Move (CVE-2025-2941)
entries.finding_summary: Unauthenticated callers pass directory traversal paths in cart item data parameters, causing `rename()` to move arbitrary server files into public upload directories. Verified by Iridium (CVE-2025-2941, finding 0, JOB-WP-VERIFY).

entries.finding_title: Dynamic hook dispatcher — unchecked do_action/apply_filters hook-name injection (CVE-2024-34370)
entries.finding_summary: An ungated AJAX handler concatenates attacker-controlled request parameters into WordPress hook names passed to `do_action()` / `apply_filters()` without capability checks, nonces, or an allowlist. Callers can fire privileged internal action callbacks that mutate sensitive options (e.g. `users_can_register`). Verified by Iridium (CVE-2024-34370, finding 28883, JOB-8CA9E7).

entries.finding_title: Elementor Pro forms multi_part_array_bypass upload (CVE-2026-32475)
entries.finding_summary: Unauthenticated callers POST multipart to `admin-ajax.php?action=elementor_pro_forms_send_form`. Validation iterates `$_FILES['form_fields']` and escapes early on an empty `[0]` part while the unvalidated `[1]` PHP payload is written under `wp-content/uploads/elementor/forms/`. Verified by Iridium (CVE-2026-32475, finding 34174, JOB-3CAF1F).

entries.finding_title: WP File Manager exposed elFinder connector.minimal.php arbitrary upload (CVE-2020-25213)
entries.finding_summary: Unauthenticated callers POST multipart to the publicly reachable `connector.minimal.php` elFinder endpoint. There is no WordPress auth gate; the connector writes the attacker filename under `lib/files` / uploads. Verified by Iridium (CVE-2020-25213, finding 28409, JOB-3FE701).

entries.finding_title: WEDevs ERP GmailSync save_attachments inbound mail AFU (CVE-2026-18080)
entries.finding_summary: `GmailSync::save_attachments` (and the IMAP twin path) writes attachment `name` under `wp-content/uploads/crm-attachments/` via `put_contents` without sanitizing `../` traversal. A crafted inbound email attachment name escapes into web-reachable uploads. Verified by Iridium (CVE-2026-18080, finding 0, JOB-WP-VERIFY).

entries.finding_title: Everest Forms stored entry-meta PHP object injection (CVE-2026-3296) (CVE-2026-10196, CVE-2026-3296, CVE-2026-78175)
entries.finding_summary: Public Everest Forms fields are stored in `evf_entrymeta` and later `unserialize($meta_value)`'d in the admin entries view without `allowed_classes` (CVE-2026-3296 / SEOPress stored_meta_poi class). Verified by Iridium (CVE-2026-10196, CVE-2026-3296, CVE-2026-78175, finding 34538, JOB-AFC3BC).

entries.finding_title: File Away fileaway-manager act=upload (CVE-2025-2512)
entries.finding_summary: Unauthenticated callers POST multipart to `admin-ajax.php?action=fileaway-manager` with `act=upload`. There is no `current_user_can()`; extension checks miss `.pht`. Verified by Iridium (CVE-2025-2512, finding 0, JOB-WP-VERIFY).

entries.finding_title: QR JSON + multipart logo/qr_image AFU (Flex QR CVE-2025-10041 class)
entries.finding_summary: Nopriv AJAX (`flexqr_save_qr` / `flexqr_update_qr`) accepts attacker `qrData` JSON then `move_uploaded_file` for `logo` / `qr_image` without a capability gate or executable-extension deny list. Verified by Iridium (CVE-2025-10041, finding 0, JOB-WP-VERIFY).

entries.finding_title: Fancy Product Designer TOCTOU image-fetch SSRF (CVE-2024-13845)
entries.finding_summary: An unauthenticated caller POSTs to `admin-ajax.php?action=fpd_upload_image` with attacker-controlled `image_url`. The handler validates scheme (and optionally snapshots DNS via `gethostbynamel`) in step 1, sleeps, then fetches the original URL in step 2 with `wp_remote_get` without re-pinning the resolved IP — enabling DNS rebinding / redirect flips to internal targets (CVE-2024-13845 class). Verified by Iridium (CVE-2024-13845, finding 28554, JOB-45B227).

entries.finding_title: Fusion Builder privacy delete (CVE-2026-8713)
entries.finding_summary: Unauth `fusion_form_submit_ajax` privacy-delete path calls `wp_delete_file` on attacker-controlled paths (CVE-2026-8713). Verified by Iridium (CVE-2026-8713, finding 38450, JOB-4A89B1).

entries.finding_title: Broken realpath allowlist then include original path (GEO my WP CVE-2026-85200 class)
entries.finding_summary: Unauthenticated AJAX callers supply an absolute or traversal path in nested form fields (e.g. `form[info_window_template][content_path]`). The handler validates with `realpath()` / `strpos` allowlisting, then `require`/`include`s the **original** attacker expression — or builds the allowlist root as `realpath(...).DIRECTORY_SEPARATOR` (false concatenates to `/`). Verified by Iridium (CVE-2026-85200, finding 58832, JOB-99A94A).

entries.finding_title: Gutenberg block-renderer unsanitized attribute SSR XSS (CVE-2024-2039, CVE-2024-31110, CVE-2024-31111)
entries.finding_summary: A dynamic Gutenberg block registers `render_callback` that echoes attacker-controlled block attributes without escaping. Contributors (or higher) can trigger the sink through WordPress core REST `/wp-json/wp/v2/block-renderer/<block>` (ServerSideRender), reflecting raw HTML/JS into the rendered payload. Verified by Iridium (CVE-2024-2039, CVE-2024-31110, CVE-2024-31111, finding 28880, JOB-EE1D33).

entries.app_name: Hash Form – Drag & Drop Form Builder
entries.finding_title: Hash Form Fine Uploader XHR qqfile upload (CVE-2026-81780)
entries.finding_summary: Unauthenticated callers POST raw octets to `admin-ajax.php?action=hashform_file_upload_action&qqfile=…`. Empty filtered `allowedExtensions` is treated as unrestricted; files land under `wp-content/uploads/hashform/`. Verified by Iridium (CVE-2026-81780, finding 27635, JOB-070A46).

entries.finding_title: Hide My WP Ghost unauthenticated file-proxy SSRF via hmwp_url (CVE-2026-81806)
entries.finding_summary: Hide My WP Ghost (and siblings) rebuild the request URL from client-controlled `HTTP_HOST` + attacker `hmwp_url` (when dynamic file mapping is enabled) inside `getCurrentURL`, then `showFile` forwards matching `wp-json` paths with `wp_remote_get` / `wp_remote_post`. A Host userinfo breakout (`Host: site@127.0.0.1:8888`) plus path-only `hmwp_url=/wp-json/...` (getValue strips `@`/`:`) makes the WordPress server request arbitrary destinations (CVE-2026-81806). Verified by Iridium (CVE-2026-81806, finding 59981, JOB-97394E).

entries.finding_title: iControlWP / Worpit Unauthenticated Link→Auth Privilege Escalation (CVE-2026-34901)
entries.finding_summary: On a fresh/unlinked install, unauthenticated callers can leak the plugin `auth_key` via `geticwppluginurl=1`, link the site with an attacker-chosen pin through `worpit_link` without an OpenSSL signature, then call `icwpapi` `m=auth` to obtain a WordPress administrator session cookie via `setAuthorizedUser()` in `src/processors/plugin_api.php:1`. Verified by Iridium (CVE-2026-34901, finding 0, JOB-WP-VERIFY).

entries.finding_title: Key-canon denylist bypass → error_log → advisor stored XSS (CVE-2026-96561)
entries.finding_summary: A public chatbot/REST handler strips sensitive keys by exact name (e.g. `model`) before `convert_keys` / snake→camel canonicalization. Trailing-underscore aliases such as `model_` survive the denylist, become `model`, and are embedded in Exception messages that `error_log()` writes with CR/LF intact. An Advisor/dashboard path later echoes log-derived option content without `esc_html`. Verified by Iridium (CVE-2026-96561, finding 0, JOB-WP-VERIFY).

entries.finding_title: Kirki unauthenticated stored XSS via REST kirki-comment (CVE-2026-17037)
entries.finding_summary: `handle_post_comment` on REST `KirkiComponentLibrary/v1/kirki-comment` accepts the `comment` parameter, runs `sanitize_text_field` without `html_entity_decode`, and persists into `comment_content` (including raw `$wpdb->update` on edit). Entity-encoded markup survives storage and executes when a user views an injected page/admin comments list (CVE-2026-17037). Patched in 6.2.1. Verified by Iridium (CVE-2026-17037, finding 59370, JOB-30602F).

entries.finding_title: Kubio Page Builder Local File Inclusion (CVE-2025-2294)
entries.finding_summary: Unauthenticated callers pass directory traversal sequences in template parameters, reaching `include`/`require` sinks without sanitization. Verified by Iridium (CVE-2025-2294, finding 22697, JOB-EBB8FB).

entries.finding_title: LiteSpeed Cache Cookie Role Simulation (CVE-2024-28000)
entries.finding_summary: Unauthenticated callers who can supply matching `litespeed.router.hash` cookies (`litespeed_role` + `litespeed_hash`) trigger `is_role_simulation()` in `src/router.cls.php:1`, which calls `wp_set_current_user()` for an attacker-chosen user id without a cryptographic authentication check. Verified by Iridium (CVE-2024-28000, finding 22544, JOB-EC2F87).

entries.finding_title: Live Composer contributor shortcode PHP object injection (CVE-2026-16502)
entries.finding_summary: A Contributor (or higher) can plant a shortcode whose body is a serialized PHP object. The registered callback calls `unserialize($content)` / `unserialize($atts)` without `allowed_classes => false`, so rendering the post instantiates the object (CVE-2026-16502 class). Wordfence rates this High because a POP chain in another plugin/theme/core can escalate to RCE or file operations. Verified by Iridium (CVE-2026-16502, finding 63411, JOB-B2B332).

entries.finding_title: Master Addons popup_id post object BAC (CVE-2026-62089)
entries.finding_summary: Authenticated AJAX handlers accept attacker-controlled post/popup IDs and call wp_delete_post / wp_update_post after only check_ajax_referer — no current_user_can('edit_post'|'delete_post', $id). Verified by Iridium (CVE-2026-62089, finding 0, JOB-WP-VERIFY).

entries.finding_title: Masteriyo LMS REST chunked import create_file AFU (CVE-2026-73996)
entries.finding_summary: A low-privilege authenticated user who can create courses can POST multipart to the Masteriyo REST courses/import endpoint with attacker-controlled fileName + chunkIndex/totalChunks. FileHandler::create_file writes under wp-content/uploads/masteriyo/import/courses/ before the JSON-only allowlist that applies only to the non-chunked path. Verified by Iridium (CVE-2026-73996, finding 0, JOB-WP-VERIFY).

entries.finding_title: Upload mime filter injection — add_filter(upload_mimes / wp_check_filetype_and_ext) (CVE-2023-40000)
entries.finding_summary: An ungated AJAX (or shortcode init) handler calls `add_filter('upload_mimes', …)` and/or `add_filter('wp_check_filetype_and_ext', …)` without capability or nonce checks. Once planted, these filters globally relax WordPress extension policy so `.php` uploads succeed via the handler and on standard media endpoints. Verified by Iridium (CVE-2023-40000, finding 28887, JOB-EF5AB5).

entries.finding_title: Multisite switch_to_blog BAC — missing current_user_can_for_blog (CVE-2026-65640 class)
entries.finding_summary: A low-privilege authenticated caller POSTs to `admin-ajax.php?action=iridium_ms_switch_mutate` (or equivalent network/sub-site management AJAX) with attacker-controlled `blog_id`. The handler calls `switch_to_blog($blog_id)` then creates/promotes an administrator / mutates options without `current_user_can_for_blog()` or `current_user_can_for_site()` — Site A abusing context switching against Site B. Verified by Iridium (CVE-2026-65640, finding 28890, JOB-A5553F).

entries.finding_title: Ninja Forms Uploads nf_fu_upload arbitrary upload (CVE-2026-0740 class)
entries.finding_summary: Unauthenticated callers POST multipart to `admin-ajax.php?action=nf_fu_upload` with no capability/nonce/extension gate; files land under `uploads/ninja-forms/`. Verified by Iridium (CVE-2026-0740, finding 0, JOB-WP-VERIFY).

entries.finding_title: Nokri empty reset token ATO (CVE-2026-18550) (CVE-2023-32243, CVE-2026-18350, CVE-2026-18550)
entries.finding_summary: `nokri_reset_password` accepts an empty reset token and calls `reset_password` without `check_password_reset_key` (CVE-2026-18550; sometimes miscited as CVE-2026-18350). Same class as Essential Addons CVE-2023-32243. Verified by Iridium (CVE-2023-32243, CVE-2026-18350, CVE-2026-18550, finding 37241, JOB-D2E84D).

entries.finding_title: Perfmatters PMCS delete unlink (CVE-2026-4350)
entries.finding_summary: `PMCS::action_handler` / AJAX passes `$_GET['delete']` to `unlink` without uploads confinement (Perfmatters CVE-2026-4350). Verified by Iridium (CVE-2026-4350, finding 38450, JOB-4A89B1).

entries.finding_title: PHP Everywhere block attr eval (CVE-2022-24663)
entries.finding_summary: Low-privileged users (subscriber+) can execute arbitrary PHP through the `[php_everywhere]` shortcode and/or the PHP Everywhere Gutenberg block. `shortcode.php` `eval()`s shortcode content and `php_everywhere_code` post meta; `block/front/block.php` `eval()`s `urldecode(base64_decode($attributes['code']))`. PoC must write content then render — not a public-nonce REST eval claim. Verified by Iridium (CVE-2022-24663, finding 24330, JOB-2BD170).

entries.finding_title: Pie Forms format_classic control-flow upload (CVE-2025-12528)
entries.finding_summary: Unauthenticated visitors submit a public Pie Forms page with a file field. `validate_classic` / `validate_extension` populate `task->errors` for disallowed extensions, but `format_classic` still calls `move_uploaded_file` — so `.pht`/dangerous extensions land under `wp-content/uploads/pieforms/`. entries.finding_title: Plupload chunked assemble-before-validate arbitrary file upload (CVE-2026-87796)

entries.finding_title: Royal Elementor wpr_addons_upload_file user-controlled allowlist (CVE-2023-5360)
